items.text: Leave the hotel. Konbini breakfast on the way.
Walk to Kyoto-Kawaramachi (~15 min), then Hankyu via Katsura to Arashiyama (¥240). Check the Sunday timetable.
On the way: Togetsukyō Bridge, just after sunrise (~6:35). Free.
Hankyu Arashiyama Stn → Togetsukyō, then on to the bamboo path (use the Bamboo Forest pin).
Bamboo path, before the crowds. Open 24 h, free.
Tenryū-ji garden via the north gate on the bamboo path (¥500). Early opening from 7:30 on 14–30 Nov. Halls (+¥300) from 8:30 and Cloud Dragon don't fit before Ōkōchi.
Free gap before Ōkōchi opens: short climb to the gorge view.
Or a quiet walk in Kameyama park.
Probably not: opens 9:00 or 10:00 (sources differ), after the gap.
Opens 9:00, clashes with Ōkōchi.
Up the end of the bamboo path to Ōkōchi Sansō.
Ōkōchi Sansō villa garden (¥1,000; keep the ticket for the matcha and sweet). This is the snack before the tour.
North through the Ogura-yama lanes (Jōjakkō-ji, Nison-in) to Giō-ji.
Giō-ji moss garden (¥300). 📿 stamp.
Optional: walk north through the preserved street (free).
Optional: 8,000 stone memorials and the quiet bamboo path (¥500). Then ~25–30 min walk to Saga-Arashiyama Stn for the ~12:15 train. No slack.
Walk back to JR Saga-Arashiyama Stn.
JR Sagano Line Saga-Arashiyama → Nijō, then walk east along the castle wall to Higashi-Ōte-mon.
No lunch before the tour: grab something small near Nijō Stn if needed.
Samurai Walking Tour 13:00–16:00, admission included. Meet 12:50 outside Higashi-Ōte-mon Gate, TripTomo sign. Don't buy tickets or enter first. Gojōin card, not a 📿 stamp.
Late lunch near the castle or on the way back: soba or yudōfu, chosen on the spot.
Tōzai Line Nijōjō-mae → Sanjō Keihan, Keihan → Kiyomizu-Gojō; or taxi.
Free time after ~17:00. Dinner chosen on the spot, or K16 / K15 if booked.
